notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Extracts IP addresses from the subdomain resolution loop output to build a list suitable for Shodan enrichment. Shodan returns open ports, service banners, SSL configuration, and vulnerability flags without the tester touching the target directly.

=== CHAINING ===
crtsh-unique-subdomains → host resolution loop → extract IPs → shodan host <IP> loop → identify high-value targets (multiple open ports, vulnerable versions) → prioritize for active scanning.
